notes.title: Updated to 1.3.5
notes.notes:
Changes:

- Enemy animation frames slowed down
- B1>B1>B4 (At the cost of Two Heat Tabs) combo to Blazing Fists
- Lower health for Jenny Jackrabbits, Hunny Bunnies
- Clash and Counterattack window a lot wider
- Changed around enemy placement.

We're still messing around with the game throughout the week, making it a better experience and addressing most of the combat issues. Thank you for your patience.
